title: Homogenization of a relaxed compressible viscous two-phase fluid model in a domain with very tiny holes
summary: We study an approximate system for the compressible Navier-Stokes-Korteweg equations in a bounded domain periodically perforated by small obstacles. As the size of the obstacles decrease much faster to zero than their mutual distances, we show in spatial dimension two and three that the limiting system remains unchanged. Our result applies for a large class of monotone and non-monotone pressure functions.
